abbrev Era := Nat

def eOf (b : Era × Nat) : Era := b.1

abbrev Node := Nat

  QII : Finset Node

def cfgE : Era → Config

  | _ => ⟨{0, 1, 3}, {0, 1, 3}⟩

def FixableIn (b : Era × Nat) (s : Era) : Prop := s = b.1 ∨ s = b.1 + 1

  | _ => ⟨[0, 1, 3], [0, 1, 3]⟩
